invented.quote: Most of my working day is spent teaching people to handle hazardous materials by following written procedures exactly, and then checking that they can.
invented.why: The brief only says the applicant teaches five high school chemistry classes a year and does not state that most of their working day is spent teaching students to handle hazardous materials by following written procedures.
The brief gives the year 2019 for when the lab safety program was written, but does not give the current year or say that seven years have passed since then.

invented.quote: I also measure my teaching and revise it based on the results.
invented.why: The brief states that the AP Chemistry pass rate rose from 41% to 58%, but does not say the applicant measures and revises their teaching or that this caused the increase.
